findings.title: Stale session capture can make the button toggle fail
findings.message: The button's Activate closure captures the session value from render time. If the session changes between renders (e.g. an edit or Dismiss closes the panel and increments the session) and the UI still holds the stale button node, a click is silently ignored. Toggle activation can also invalidate the currently open editor's callbacks, because it bumps the session while open, so edits from that render are rejected until the next View.
findings.suggestion: Do not gate the toggle on the captured session; check only available(). Increment the session only when closing (use p.close()), not when opening.
